---
title: "Annotated Results: HIC vs Year"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

files <- tibble(
  path = c(
    "annotated_results.csv",
    "annotated_results_m50_bucket15.csv",
    "annotated_results_m50_bucket36.csv",
    "annotated_results_f5_bucket15.csv",
    "annotated_results_f5_bucket36.csv"
  )
) %>% filter(file.exists(path))

if (nrow(files) == 0) {
  stop("No annotated_results*.csv files found in the working directory.")
}

read_and_tag <- function(path) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  name <- basename(path)
  if (grepl("m50", name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    role <- "M50"
    df <- df %>%
      transmute(
        make, model, year = as.numeric(year),
        role,
        source = name,
        hic_bucket = hic_bucket,
        raw_hic = as.numeric(HIC_m50),
        norm_hic = as.numeric(normalizedHIC_m50)
      )
  } else if (grepl("f5", name, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    role <- "F5"
    df <- df %>%
      transmute(
        make, model, year = as.numeric(year),
        role,
        source = name,
        hic_bucket = hic_bucket,
        raw_hic = as.numeric(HIC_f5),
        norm_hic = as.numeric(normalizedHIC_f5)
      )
  } else {
    # combined file: keep both roles separately and combined normalized
    combined <- df %>%
      transmute(
        make, model, year = as.numeric(year),
        role = "Combined",
        source = name,
        hic_bucket = hic_bucket,
        raw_hic = NA_real_,
        norm_hic = as.numeric(normalizedHIC)
      )
    m50 <- df %>%
      transmute(
        make, model, year = as.numeric(year),
        role = "M50",
        source = name,
        hic_bucket = hic_bucket,
        raw_hic = as.numeric(HIC_m50),
        norm_hic = as.numeric(normalizedHIC_m50)
      )
    f5 <- df %>%
      transmute(
        make, model, year = as.numeric(year),
        role = "F5",
        source = name,
        hic_bucket = hic_bucket,
        raw_hic = as.numeric(HIC_f5),
        norm_hic = as.numeric(normalizedHIC_f5)
      )
    return(bind_rows(combined, m50, f5))
  }
  df
}

data <- files %>%
  mutate(tbl = map(path, read_and_tag)) %>%
  pull(tbl) %>%
  bind_rows()

data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))

glimpse(data)
```

## Raw HIC vs Year (all points, faceted by HIC bucket)

```{r raw-all, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot(filter(data, !is.na(raw_hic)), aes(year, raw_hic, color = role)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, position = position_jitter(width = 0.35, height = 0)) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Raw HIC vs Year",
    x = "Model Year",
    y = "Raw HIC"
  ) +
  facet_grid(role ~ hic_bucket, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Raw HIC vs Year (yearly average, faceted by HIC bucket)

```{r raw-yearly, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
raw_year <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(raw_hic)) %>%
  group_by(year, role, hic_bucket) %>%
  summarise(raw_hic = mean(raw_hic, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(raw_year, aes(year, raw_hic, color = role)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, method = "loess") +
  labs(
    title = "Raw HIC vs Year (Yearly Mean)",
    x = "Model Year",
    y = "Raw HIC (mean)"
  ) +
  facet_grid(role ~ hic_bucket, scales = "free_y") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_minimal()
```
